author: The Wall Street Journal
description:
The Wall Street Journal gained behind-the-scenes access to the set of “Vicious,” a microdrama produced by ReelShort, the app at the center of a short-form video boom. These 90-second dramas draw millions of U.S. viewers, and ReelShort briefly rivaled TikTok for the top spot on the U.S. App Store. 

We explain how this bite-sized storytelling model is disrupting the American streaming landscape and challenging established platforms like Netflix.

5:09 The creative aspect
